bullets.text: Police detained two lorry drivers for murdering a colleague during an altercation near Sholavaram, and the office should monitor the investigation.
Students face forced fee collections at Quaide Milleth College in Medavakkam on the Tambaram-Velachery road, and the office should investigate the allegations.
Three members of the same family passed away consecutively in Thiruvallur district, and the office should verify the cause and offer support.

stories.title: Missing lorry driver beaten to death and buried near Sholavaram, two held
takeaways: A missing lorry driver was beaten to death and buried in Sholavaram within Tiruvallur district.
Two suspects have been detained by local police following a drunken altercation.

stories.title: கட்டாய வசூலில் காயிதே மில்லத் கல்லூரி! -மாணவர்களைக் காப்பாற்றுமா அரசு?
takeaways: Quaide Milleth College on the Tambaram-Velachery road faces allegations of compulsory fee collections.
Students and observers are urging government intervention to protect students from financial exploitation.
